draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
revised_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) report that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to the unfiltered summarizer across the three news summarization benchmarks they evaluated.
